root: ^Young lady, you're not only amazing at cards retrieving but also have great memory!
^Thank you, sir. So... will you let Tweedle Dum go now?
^But of course! Practice with you reminded me all my tricks for this game and I for sure will amaze the audience with the sharpness of both my eyes and mind.
^I'm more than happy to do so.
^Oh...!  A pirate's life is a life for me!
